changes.finding: BC Builds: fits the published criteria: non-residential space is 0.0% of area, under the 30% cap; ground must break within 12 to 18 months of the conditional land contribution letter.

12 storeys puts the building under Part 3 of the BC Building Code 2024 and the Vancouver Building By-law 2025; wood frame is standard to 6 storeys and encapsulated mass timber is permitted to 18 under the VBBL; seismic changes apply to permits from 2026-09-15.

Community Housing Fund: fit cannot be confirmed without the land tenure (lease of at least 60 years at nominal value, or ownership). Unit mix matches 30/50/20 within tolerance; Site control (finalized) meets the readiness bar; Construction must be able to start within 18 months of award; Program status: 2025 call (RFP #1070-2526-022) cancelled Feb 2026; program page says it will post when next seeking proposals (as of 22 Sep 2026).
BC Housing minimum net unit areas are studio 33, one-bedroom 49, two-bedroom 67, three-bedroom 86 m²; the option averages 80 m² gross per unit, so net areas should be checked at the plan stage.
48 of 120 units (40.0%) have two or more bedrooms, against a 35.0% minimum.
No minimum off-street parking applies citywide since June 2024; the option provides 30 vehicle and 220 bicycle spaces, which are set by the Parking By-law at the development permit stage.
Meets the City's social housing definition: 30.0% of units for households below HILs (minimum 30.0%), owned by a city, secured for 60 years.
